description.en: Opens the official DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) as a full-page view inside DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar entry renders the real page in the center column through the desktop shell's native browser guest, so the official client keeps its model picker, deep think, smart search, history and attachments. Hosts without that guest bridge fall back to opening a window. No chat UI, no agent tools, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内以整页视图打开 chat.deepseek.com 官方网页版：点侧边栏入口，真实页面通过桌面端的原生浏览器访客渲染在中栏，因此模型选择、深度思考、智能搜索、历史记录、附件上传仍是官方那一套。宿主没有该访客桥接时降级为打开窗口。不含自研聊天界面与 agent 工具，也没有运行时依赖。
